messages:
Nina R: Quick flag from today's Helio Health sync. Renewal in ~28 days. They reported three blockers that are affecting adoption: 1) embeddings latency spikes after large batch runs; 2) invoices don't show per-route breakdown causing accounting confusion; 3) onboarding docs assume hosted defaults and lack on-prem memory tuning. They asked for an emergency export of route-level usage + a short runbook.

Carlos M: Oof. Do we have a repro? Which model/quantization and Dedicated pool are they on?

Nina R: They're on dedicated `hh-prod-rt` using open-llama-7b int8. Repro: bulk embed job of ~180k docs, then live search; latency jumps from ~300ms to 2s for some queries after index update. Zendesk ticket: #HH-6789.

Ivy (CS): Customer quote: "We love the retrieval quality, but the slowness and mystery bills make renewals hard to justify." They want a CSV export of per-route tokens + cost, and an "embeddings health" snapshot.

Theo (PM): Priorities: 1) Per-route CSV export (P0 quick win) 2) Investigate latency (P1 deeper root cause) 3) Docs + enablement session (P1, low dev effort). If we can deliver (1) quickly, offer guided enablement + temporary credits to buy time.

Rahul: I can prototype the CSV export endpoint today: `/api/v1/usage/export?workspace_id=...&since=...&route=...`. Proposed columns: `route, workspace_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, est_cost_usd, time_window_start, time_window_end`. Will that satisfy finance?

Ivy (CS): That should work. Also request that the export include `deployment_type` and `model_variant` fields so we can correlate.

Rahul: Noted. Including those columns. ETA: PR by EOD, staging deploy tomorrow morning. Will add a Console export button for last-30d by route.

Carlos M: For latency - please capture `REDWOOD_DEBUG=1` traces and GPU stats. If they're on Dedicated, kernel selection or cache pressure could be the culprit. Nina, can you ask Helio to run a short trace during their next bulk job?

Nina R: Scheduled a repro session with Helio for tomorrow 10am PT. I'll ask for `sample_queries.json`, `embed_job_manifest.json`, and to re-run with debug flags. I'll attach traces here.

OpsBot: Ticket created HH-6789; owner assigned: Ivy (CS).

Theo (PM): Action items: Ivy to gather repro + live timings; Rahul to ship CSV export spike; Nina to collect traces and update renewal status; I'll prepare a one-pager for CSM with temporary mitigations (suggest smaller model, tune batch size, throttle concurrency).

Ivy (CS): I'll also prepare a short enablement session template (30m) to walk Helio through cost-export and embedding tuning. If we can't ship the export before renewal, recommend offering a one-time credit and a free enablement.

Rahul: Quick note on implementation: export will compute `est_cost_usd` using per-model per-token rates and include a `confidence` column (low/med/high) if any aggregation is partial.

Carlos M: Good. Once we have traces, I'll pair with infra to check kernel selection logs and memory usage. If it's quantization mismatch, we might recommend a model variant fallback.

Theo (PM): Let's reconvene 24h after the repro session. Marking account with `renewal:watch` for now. Thanks everyone.

Nina R: Adding links to ticket and docs once available: https://zendesk.redwood/HH-6789/logs. I'll post trace extracts here after the session. :thumbsup:
